findings.statement: Seventeen prescribed P9+Q8 cones alone do not imply root degree17: adding the omitted P10 cone yields an 18-member SF4 star. The manuscript instead assumes the complete degree17 link when deriving the residual count and classifying root forms.

Independent bounded enumeration found no allowed core-trace counterexample for any P9 omission and any of the three I8 models. Explicit small SF4 negative controls show why the mixed-triple exclusion and complete-link distinctions are necessary; both are preserved in the proof. No counterexample to the stated theorem or required revision was found. This round does not replay the finite leaves supplying the terminal hypotheses.
